title: I would like your opinion, does this looks good ?
author: dancingwithlies
selftext:
So i am making a tactics iso open world game inspired by FFT/Wakfu etc, and i inspired the looks of this specific BIOME on Ghibli movies, how does it look ? WIP - btw ignore the lag, i had like 3 unity editors open at the same time xd

If you consider it is the work of a team of 8 people, but only 2 programmers, 2 artists, the rest didnt work on anything related to this video, and it took 1 month and half i think, good enough ? its on Unity

I still want to improve the blocks and trees etc, but how is the overall vibe for this biome ?

comments.author: dknos_dev
comments.body: Looks pretty good, but stiff without shadows.

replies.author: dancingwithlies
replies.body: Hey thanks for the feedback, but stiff without shadows ? what exactly you meant by that ?

replies.author: Nerisma
replies.body: The character is missing some shadows, that's really it :)

replies.author: dancingwithlies
replies.body: Ok, it has shadows but its just not visible here, so i get it, i will work on that, thanks

replies.author: dknos_dev
replies.body: The shadows on the hero look off(not there), compared to the trees

comments.author: DamienNF
comments.body: You have a pretty big team, are you sure this is the correct sub? Actually it looks good, I would consider maybe moving sunrays a bot slower but it is just for my taste

replies.author: dancingwithlies
replies.body:
I mean i am one of the programmers and this is almost all my own work, using AI too, so i guess i can post here ? xd

And thanks for the feedback, i was thinking about that too

comments.author: rmfrost
comments.body:
* good colors for grass, and the movement of it seems pretty nice
* trees look really bland, like early game filler assets. more branches, less "straight up and down" (if they were pine trees, that'd be a different story so long as the "layers" of leaves were done well)
* lighting seems pretty good
* clouds' shadows make them seem not real, crisper cloud outlines in more consistent shapes would help
* if you're doing a tactics-esk game, it doesn't seem like the elevation differences between block levels is high enough to match that art style. at most, each block elevation change should be half a step minimum instead of what appears to be 0.1-th of a step up or down.
* is the character filler? their drawn perspective isn't isometric, their arms are hung way away from their body, and the 2d sprite-nature feels out of place with all the custom lighting and such.

replies.author: dancingwithlies
replies.body:
Thanks for the feedback

\- I really like the grass too, i made many versions to get it  
\- I am planning on improving the trees, so i agree with you  
\- I will work on the clouds shadows, i agree with you again  
\- Yeah that is a concern, but i dont want the player to be jumping everywhere like in minecraft, so i tried to make a lower step, i will see if i can make it higher without feeling like the character should jump and not just walk to get on top of it  
\- No, the character is the main character, a artist drawn it and another one made the animation of the first drawning, maybe the excessive focus on lighting from my part is breaking the character art style ? what do you think ? maybe if i made the character brighter ?

replies.author: Smashdaisaku85
replies.body: I basically agree with the comment you replied to above. There’s a little bit of an awkwardness with the main character: both the way his arms are spread way out from his sides and the way he’s carrying his sword looks very unnatural. If the artists insist on keeping his arms like that, then I would insist that his sword is stored sheathed on his back while he’s just walking around and exploring.

comments.author: akanas
comments.body:
From gamers perspective - looks mediocre at best. Most likely because of the lag.  
From ai game dev perspective - 1 month to build this?! Are you sure you used AI? Also if you're making some kind of presentation, make sure everything about it is good. There shouldn't have been any lags.

replies.author: dancingwithlies
replies.body:
DId you even read the post ? and 1 month not just for the current look, theres a entire procedural tooling for the grass/terrain/trees, it will be a open world map with multiple biomes, similar to Minecraft map style.

And idk if lag has anything to do with design, so if it "looks" mediocre because of lag then idk if i agree bro, but like, if its not only lag then please let me know what is bad about it and i will try to improve

replies.author: IsThisASnakeInMyBoot
replies.body: It's more that if you're showing it off you should probably do it with as minimal lag as you can

replies.author: dancingwithlies
replies.body: i mean sure i understand, my bad for the lag

comments.author: prime-rick
comments.body: I think the more AI games I see, the more I appreciate real games made by people

replies.author: dancingwithlies
replies.body: I mean i am the people, or you think this is a 1 prompt shot ? my taste/design is on it, but you are free to dislike it, i just dont agree that it looks like the common "slop"

replies.author: prime-rick
replies.body:
I'm sure it requires efforts. Not saying it's slop but for sure a game made by AI is rarely fun. 
People are using hundreds of dollars in making they games with AI. Why can't you just hire real artists and take their help instead?

replies.author: dancingwithlies
replies.body: We have real artists, the character is hand drawn and animated, i use AI to make the tools, then i use the tools to get the look i want

replies.author: prime-rick
replies.body:
Ah. I see. My bad bro. It'll turn out to be a good game I think. 
My fault I didn't read the whole post.

replies.author: dancingwithlies
replies.body: No problem, i appreciate the concern tho, i will try to not make slop

comments.author: EngineeringBoth976
comments.body: Looks good, good job, but I'd make the character stand out from the background more.

replies.author: dancingwithlies
replies.body: Thank you, i will try, i see this issue as well, i dont want the art team to get mad at me xd

comments.author: ArtArtArt123456
comments.body:
looks unique enough, which is a good starting point. needs a lot of polish though. and the way the character holds the sword looks sloppy to me.

there is a disjoint between the character and the environment. the environment does not look very unique. and the trees actually look pretty lame. it feels pretty empty in general.

replies.author: dancingwithlies
replies.body: Ok, i understand, the main thing i am working rn is how to make the environment look less lame/empty, any ideas would be appreciated

comments.body:
I grew up on iso MMOs so this comes from a place of love for the art. 

This looks fucking awful. I'm not saying this to be mean, or anti ai or whatever but literally everything except the mouse visor is really bad.

replies.author: dancingwithlies
replies.body: I mean ok, but i would like you to be more specific about why it is awful

comments.body: It doesn't look bad, but it also doesn't feel like that much of a step up from like Adventure Quest if anyone remembers that

replies.body: I agree, and the clouds shape and speed is completely controllable, so i will work on that, thanks for the feedback

replies.author: IsThisASnakeInMyBoot
replies.body: No worries, good luck on the project
